name: telomi-local-qwen-stt-v1
description: Local Qwen3-ASR ordinary-dictation release corpus. Source-authored public human speech covers Mandarin, English, Mandarin-English code switching, structured values and technical terms. Versioned deterministic derivatives cover long pauses, 5 dB white noise, weak onset, keyboard-like short bursts and simulated far-field professional-term boundaries. Public real acoustic recordings add DEMAND living-room noise, Sony pantograph keyboard sounds and direct AMI table-top microphone-array speech without being counted as local hardware evidence. Included diagnostic suites keep each case definition single-sourced. The remaining hardware coverage blockers are five real acoustic-condition recordings across the two verified microphones: room noise and keyboard noise for each device, plus one fixed-microphone far-field capture.
